title: Apoorva Lakhia says Salman Khan filmed in freezing rain
description: Salman Khan shot in -7°C rain without acclimatising for ‘Maatrubhumi: May War Rest In Peace’, director Apoorva Lakhia revealed. The film was shot at 14,000 feet, in temperatures dropping to -40°C. Khan reportedly did three takes without extra oxygen. Produced by Salman Khan Films, it also stars Chitrangda Singh.

title: Johnny Depp’s ‘Ebenezer’ opens strong with $42 million debut
description: Johnny Depp's latest film 'Ebenezer' achieved a remarkable $42 million box office debut across several regions. The film, directed by Tim West, is inspired by Charles Dickens' classic novel 'A Christmas Carol'. Depp portrays Ebenezer Scrooge, a character who undergoes a significant transformation through ghostly encounters. The film was released on November 12 in North America, the UK, and Japan. Audiences in India can expect its release on November 20.

title: Allu Arjun praises Dulquer Salmaan at ‘Aakasamlo Oka Tara’ event

Dulquer, in turn, acknowledged Allu's immense fanbase and shared what this film means to him on a personal level. 'Aakasamlo Oka Tara' focuses on Ammulu's struggles and aspirations, with a theatrical release scheduled for November 20.

title: 'Pathira Kurukkan' release
description: Debut director Jayesh Venugopal's film, Pathira Kurukkan, is set to hit theaters on December 11. This movie marks the return of beloved actors Jagadish, Mukesh, Siddique, and Ashokan, who last shared the screen 16 years ago. Their comedic chemistry, combined with contributions from other familiar faces, promises plenty of laughs. Additionally, the lead actors will join forces for a song, making this collaboration a significant highlight.

title: Deen Castronovo leaves Journey after 21 years
description: Deen Castronovo has decided to retire from the band Journey after serving for 21 years and facing health challenges. The band announced his retirement on their official Facebook page, expressing support during this time. Steve Murphy will temporarily replace him as the drummer for the remaining concerts on their current tour. Castronovo had previously faced medical emergencies during live performances, which contributed to his decision.

title: Matt Damon says Ben Affleck loved Robert Pattinson’s performance in ‘The Odyssey'

After viewing the film, Affleck was particularly impressed with Pattinson's take on the character Antinous. Damon remarked on how Pattinson turned a villain into a compelling character, showcasing his remarkable talent. Pattinson, who is gaining accolades for his role as Batman, is rumored to be in the running for the next James Bond.

title: Dubey thanks Ramayana audiences: Ravie says audience love eased his fear

title: Shruti Haasan recalls Kamal Haasan and Sarika's deep love

She noted how their teamwork influenced her views on love and companionship. Following their separation, Shruti recognized the crucial role of financial independence for women, stressing that their struggles often go unnoticed. Her journey underscores the importance of celebrating women's autonomy in our society.

The Tamil iteration has been pivotal, racking up Rs 18.99 crore. Despite an impressive opening, reaching the Rs 30 crore goal appears increasingly challenging for the film.

title: 'Scene' BO day 10: Earns over three times 'Aavesham'

Domestically, it earned a net of Rs 136.50 crore and a total gross of Rs 158.55 crore. Notably, its performance far surpasses Jithu Madhavan's earlier film 'Aavesham' at the same point. The film also secured Rs 4 crore from overseas, bringing its international earnings to Rs 83.

title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 11 (LIVE)
description: Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend recorded impressive box office collections during its first week of release. The film's collection reached Rs 713.51 crore net in India, with worldwide earnings of Rs 1228 crore. Significant milestones included the highest-ever Monday collection and steady ticket sales, especially in advance bookings. As of day 11, the film continued to perform well, indicating strong audience interest.
